tasks.description: Drafts a plan that maps messy file names in a folder to tidy ones without renaming anything. Use when asked for a rename plan for a cluttered folder.
tasks.intent: Propose tidy names for a cluttered folder as a plan only.

tasks.description: Groups byte-identical files in a folder and reports the space the extra copies waste. Use when asked for a duplicate file report on a folder.
tasks.intent: Report groups of identical files and wasted bytes.

tasks.description: Summarises a folder by kind of file, size and naming habits. Use when asked for a summary of what a folder contains.
tasks.intent: Summarise folder contents by category, size and naming habits.
